tree: Bluebird Pools & Spas in Scottsdale, AZ sends resurfacing and repair quotes every day. Sales lead Tara Quinn and service manager Jordan Ellis share the follow-ups.

tree.style: margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 14px; font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: #0b1620;

tree: — Tara sends Heather Dunn a $14,800.00 resurfacing quote and sets a follow-up for Tuesday 10 AM by text.
— The follow-up appears in Tara’s Due Today list with the quote attached.
— Tara reviews the text and sends it. Heather replies with questions about tile.
— Tara marks it done and sets the next follow-up for Thursday: “send tile samples”.
